headline: President Bush extended an earlier executive order, Executive Order 13381, so it stays in effect for one more year.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 13381, which had already been amended before, so that it lasts one year longer than first planned. The title does not describe any other changes. No summary was provided, so the details of what the earlier order covers are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and officials responsible for carrying out Executive Order 13381
who_it_affects.how: They must keep following the earlier order's rules for one more year instead of letting it expire.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 28, 2007; it extends the earlier order's end date by one year.
